description: We are seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to design, train, and deploy predictive and NLP models. The candidate will work with Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, and PyTorch, optimizing feature engineering pipelines and deploying scalable ML APIs.
Looking for an NLP Engineer passionate about text processing, sentiment analysis, entity extraction, and transformers. Must be proficient in Python, NLTK, spaCy, and TF-IDF similarity algorithms.

Join our data science team to extract insights from structured and unstructured data. Build statistical models, perform hypothesis testing, and create predictive models using Python, SQL, and Machine Learning.
Architect and deploy end-to-end artificial intelligence systems. Focus on integrating deep learning architectures, computer vision, and NLP pipelines into cloud-native microservices.
Seeking a backend Python Developer to develop high-performance REST APIs, integrate databases, and build automation workflows using Flask or Django.
We are hiring a Java Developer with strong core Java knowledge, Spring Boot microservices expertise, and relational database skills to build enterprise banking software.
We need a Full Stack Developer skilled in React on the frontend and Node.js or Python on the backend. Responsibilities include building responsive user interfaces and integrating database services.
Passionate Frontend Developer needed to create beautiful, responsive, and intuitive web applications. Mastery of React, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS/Tailwind is required.
Build scalable backend APIs and database schemas for real-time applications. Proficient in Node.js, Express, MongoDB, and Redis caching.
Extract, clean, and analyze large business datasets. Create dynamic dashboards, KPI reports, and actionable business insights using SQL, Excel, and Power BI.
General Software Engineer role focusing on object-oriented programming, data structures, algorithm design, and collaborative software development using C++, Java, or Python.

Exciting internship opportunity for engineering students eager to gain practical machine learning experience. Help curate training datasets, experiment with Scikit-learn models, and evaluate accuracy metrics.
Internship for aspiring Data Scientists. Work alongside senior data scientists on exploratory data analysis, data cleansing, statistical modeling, and Python scripting.
Hands-on internship in Natural Language Processing. Assist in corpus tokenization, stop-word filtering, text classification, and TF-IDF document similarity scoring.
Explore practical AI applications including neural networks, deep learning models, and computer vision algorithms. Ideal for final-year college project students.
Manage relational databases, design efficient indexes, write stored procedures, and optimize complex queries using MySQL, PostgreSQL, and SQL Server.
Automate deployment pipelines and manage cloud infrastructure using Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, and Linux scripting.
Develop low-latency, memory-efficient software in modern C++. Good grasp of multi-threading, socket programming, and Linux operating system internals.
Create cross-platform iOS and Android mobile applications using React Native, JavaScript, and TypeScript with state management.
Entry-level Python developer position building web endpoints, managing SQLite/PostgreSQL databases, and writing unit tests.
